item.title: Protests over living costs spark clashes across European nations
item.description: Demonstrators and law enforcement collided in France, Italy, and Spain. The unrest stemmed from growing anger regarding inflation and reductions in public spending.

item.description: During a UN General Assembly committee session, Indian diplomat Raghoo Puri urged Islamabad to focus on citizen welfare rather than military orders and criticized its minority record.

item.title: Ranabaali surpasses Rs 50 crore net collection in India
item.description: Starring Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna, the movie reached a domestic net milestone of over Rs 50 crore. Its second Saturday earnings grew by 33.3 percent to Rs 2.80 crores.

item.description: এক ২২ বছর বয়সী শিক্ষার্থী রয়টার্সকে জানান, জনগণ ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত দোকানপাট নিয়ে সোচ্চার হলেও যারা বছরজুড়ে অর্থনৈতিকভাবে পিছিয়ে পড়ছে, তাদের দুর্দশা কেউ দেখছে না।

item.title: Finding the most affordable new gaming console in 2026
item.description: Budget-friendly gaming hardware remains accessible despite recent price increases. However, buyers must carefully evaluate their choices to find the best value.

item.title: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 Sees 66 Percent Jump on Second Saturday
item.description: On its second Saturday, Rajinikanth's film Jailer 2 saw box office collections rise by 66.6 percent to reach Rs 24.15 crores domestically. The movie additionally brought in Rs 10 crore from international markets.

item.title: Palestinian homes demolished in Hebron amid displacement
item.description: Israeli military forces tore down houses in Hebron, displacing Palestinian families following a deadly attack by two gunmen that killed two Israeli soldiers. The demolitions occurred shortly before upcoming elections in Israel.

item.title: Unrest and Looting Lead to 1100 Arrests in France and Spain
item.description: Demonstrators clashed with police and looted stores across France and Spain, leading to approximately 1,100 arrests. Online videos captured hooded individuals breaking windows, stealing goods, and shoppers trapped inside locked stores.

item.title: Simple Tips to Maximize Apple AirTag Battery Lifespan
item.description: Apple AirTags feature easily replaceable batteries, though users may want to maximize their lifespan to avoid sudden power loss. Maintaining proper upkeep ensures the tracking devices remain operational when needed most.

item.title: Donald Trump Praises Melania Over Localized Russia-Ukraine Truce
item.description: Donald Trump commended the First Lady, describing her performance as superior to professionals. This praise followed a localized ceasefire agreement between Russia and Ukraine reached in Oleshky.

item.title: Nigerian President Tinubu Begins Reelection Campaign Amid Hardship
item.description: Nigerian President Bola Tinubu initiated his upcoming electoral campaign by promising citizens a brighter future. He attributed the widespread poverty in Africa's most populous nation to his political opponents.

item.title: Inside the Untapped Rosebank Oil Field at the Center of a Debate
item.description: BBC Scotland editor James Cook visits a vessel operating within the Rosebank oil field. The untapped offshore site currently sits at the center of a major political controversy.

item.title: Avoiding Frequent Errors During Home Network Setup
item.description: Configuring a home network can be beneficial, but certain errors should be avoided to prevent future complications. Recognizing these common pitfalls helps ensure a smoother setup process.

item.title: Four Hurt in Drive-By Shooting Near Brisbane Boxing Match
item.description: A drive-by shooting outside a Loganholme venue hosting a boxing event left four individuals injured. Perpetrators operating from a vehicle remain at large while police investigate the incident.

item.title: Andy Burnham calls for open debate on EU freedom of movement
item.description: Ahead of a November summit, Andy Burnham stated that the UK needs a transparent conversation regarding potential renewed free movement with the EU, as the prime minister explores partnership options.

item.description: Sylvester Stallone openly defended industry nepotism while addressing his daughter Scarlet's casting in Tulsa King. He argued that parents are obligated to assist their children in securing career advantages.

item.description: Legacy tracks and older musical compositions are increasingly dominating contemporary charts and streaming platforms. Analysts examine the underlying drivers behind this enduring popularity of vintage music.

item.description: Law enforcement in Nigeria reported that a heavily armed faction launched a deadly raid on Binnari village, located in Taraba State. The violent incident resulted in the deaths of a minimum of ten individuals.

item.description: Pundit Martin Keown reviewed Cole Palmer's dismissal during Chelsea's 2-0 loss to Tottenham. The former defender supported the referee's verdict while noting Palmer avoided an earlier sending-off.

item.description: Pundits Martin Keown and Steph Houghton analyzed Nicolas Jackson's instrumental performance in Aston Villa's 2-1 win over Manchester City. Keown praised the forward as a unique talent following his brace.

item.description: The upcoming movie 'Ramayana: Part 1', starring Ranbir Kapoor and Yash, is scheduled for a November 5, 2026 release. Early feedback highlights strong emotional elements and notable visual effects, with the English cut being shorter than the Hindi version.

item.description: Following a Berlin meeting with Indian academics on Friday, Piyush Goyal stated that building a supportive innovation ecosystem is vital. He plans to address this matter with administrative bodies and academic institutions.
